Behind it, a gap in the wall reveals another cavern filled with Titan technology. The altar is apparently named for Tormar Frostgut, who is lured to it when it is attacked by adventurers. __NOTOC__

Frosty Footmen are a melee ground unit of the and families in Warcraft Rumble. They are summoned as part of the entourage of , providing a constant group of guards. Arthas will resummon the two footmen when he is not actively attacking something. Even if he is being attacked, he will resummon them, meaning he may be able to reinforce himself in the middle of a fight if given some breathing room.

Fungal Fields is the southeastern extent of the greater Light's Blooming farmland in northeastern Hallowfall. The area is bordered by Duskrise Acreage to the west, Hillhelm Stead to the northwest, the Light's Blooming dawntower to the north, the Whirring Field to the northeast, and Shadowgrove Vineyards to the east. Outside the farms, Growling Hollow is further southeast.

Galan was a titan watcher appointed by Archaedas, alongside Dornic, to oversee the earthen of Khaz Algar. Galan and Dornic's arrival was met with enthusiasm and celebration by the earthen, they even proposed to name the fortress they were building after them. However, in the absence of Archaedas, Dornic turned out to be a tyrannical and oppressive leader. He imposed unreasonable demands and punished the earthen harshly, including deactivating them at his discretion. His cruelty caused widespread fear and unrest among the earthen, who eventually formed a rebellion and deactivated Dornic. Game Concessioners are goblins located at the Emerald Hills Golf Course in the Undermine.

The Gallagio ( ) is the largest building in the Undermine, serving as Jastor Gallywix's pleasure-fortress. The bottom floor is a casino, featuring slot machines and card games. After Jastor's death, the Gallagio was inherited by his nephew, Rosebud Gallywix, however, Rosebud was assassinated by Tarbonara Fizzlecrank in a ploy to seize the casino. With the aid of adventurers, Marty Zoomcart prevented the Gallagio from being sold off at auction and was made its new Chief Goblin Officer.

Gallagio Garbage is a rare elite money golem located in Undermine that has a chance of spawning when the S.C.R.A.P. event bar fills up. Defeating it is the objective of the Can You Believe What People Throw Away? achievement. After the hotfix, the spawn rate for the Gallagio Garbage was increased up to roughly 33% (from ~1%), so the rare is much more available. The rare does not have a daily lockout, so it can be repeatedly farmed on one character, and the mount can drop even if already learned.
Gallagio Deed Ammendments and Bylaws is found at the Office of Lawyering at Hovel Hill in the Undermine. It is part of the objective of Responsibility.
